goal.en: Organise a paragraph so a reader can follow your thinking without effort.
goal.ar: أن تنظّم فقرتك بحيث يتابع القارئ أفكارك دون عناء.

article.title: From an online article
article.text:
Remote work was once a rare privilege. Today, however, roughly a third of office employees in the region work from home at least two days a week. The benefits are easy to list: no commute, fewer interruptions, and lower costs for both sides. Employers, moreover, can hire outside their own city.

There is another side to it. Junior staff in particular learn a great deal by simply overhearing experienced colleagues, and that disappears at home. Managers also report that new team members take longer to settle in. As a result, many companies have settled on a hybrid arrangement rather than choosing one model outright — not because it is ideal, but because it loses the least.

head: Linker
Followed by
Example
rows: It rained, but we went out.
Although it rained, we went out.
It rained. However, we went out.
Despite the rain, we went out.
It is cheap. On the other hand, it is slow.

text.en: “However” is not a substitute for “but” inside one sentence. Write “It rained. However, we went out.” or “It rained, but we went out.” — not “It rained however we went out.”
text.ar: لا تحلّ however محل but داخل الجملة الواحدة. اكتب جملتين مع however، أو استخدم but داخل جملة واحدة.

head: Purpose
Linkers
rows: also, in addition, moreover, as well as
so, therefore, as a result, consequently
for example, for instance, such as
in short, overall, to sum up

text.en: Formal linkers (moreover, therefore, consequently) start a sentence and take a comma. Everyday ones (so, also) sit inside it.
text.ar: أدوات الربط الرسمية مثل moreover وtherefore تبدأ الجملة وتتبعها فاصلة، أما اليومية مثل so وalso فتقع داخل الجملة.

text.en: “Also” does not start a sentence in careful writing — use “In addition,” or “Moreover,”.
text.ar: لا تبدأ الجملة بـ also في الكتابة المتأنية، بل استخدم In addition أو Moreover.

text.en: A good paragraph has one idea. It usually opens with that idea, supports it with a reason or an example, and closes with a consequence.
text.ar: الفقرة الجيدة تحمل فكرة واحدة: تبدأ بها، ثم تدعمها بسبب أو مثال، ثم تختم بنتيجة.

items.en: Working from home saves time. A daily commute can cost two hours. As a result, many people now start earlier and finish earlier.
items.ar: العمل من المنزل يوفّر الوقت. فالتنقل اليومي قد يستهلك ساعتين. ونتيجة لذلك يبدأ كثيرون عملهم مبكراً وينهونه مبكراً.

text.en: When you read, the linkers tell you what is coming next. “However” warns you the writer is about to disagree with what they just said.
text.ar: عند القراءة تخبرك أدوات الربط بما سيأتي. فكلمة however تنبّهك إلى أن الكاتب سيعارض ما قاله للتو.

questions.sentence: ___ the traffic was heavy, we arrived on time.
options: Although
Despite
However
Therefore

explanation.en: A full clause follows, so “although” fits; “despite” needs a noun.
explanation.ar: يليها جملة كاملة فتناسب although، أما despite فيليها اسم.

questions.sentence: The course is expensive. ___ , it is the best one available.
options: However
Although
Despite
Whereas

explanation.en: A new sentence contrasting the last one → However, with a comma.
explanation.ar: جملة جديدة تعارض ما قبلها، فنستخدم However وبعدها فاصلة.

options: It rained however we went out anyway.
It rained, but we went out anyway.
Although it rained, we went out anyway.
Despite the rain, we went out anyway.

explanation.en: “However” cannot join two clauses like “but”. It needs a full stop or a semicolon before it.
explanation.ar: لا تربط however جملتين كما تفعل but، بل تحتاج نقطة أو فاصلة منقوطة قبلها.

questions.sentence: The train was cancelled. ___ , we had to take a taxi.
options: Therefore
Although
Whereas
Moreover

explanation.en: The second sentence is the result → Therefore.

questions.sentence: The flat is close to my office. ___ , the rent is reasonable.
options: Moreover
Therefore
However
Otherwise

explanation.en: A second advantage is being added → Moreover (or In addition).
explanation.ar: تُضاف ميزة ثانية، فنستخدم Moreover أو In addition.

prompt.en: Which linker tells the reader an example is coming?
prompt.ar: أي أداة تنبّه القارئ إلى مثال قادم؟

options: for instance
nevertheless
consequently
on the contrary

explanation.en: “For instance” and “for example” introduce evidence, not contrast or result.
explanation.ar: for instance وfor example تُدخلان مثالاً، لا تضاداً ولا نتيجة.

prompt.en: Which sentence is weakest in formal writing?
prompt.ar: أي جملة أضعف في الكتابة الرسمية؟

options: Also, the price has increased this year.
In addition, the price has increased.
The price has also increased this year.
Moreover, the price has increased.

explanation.en: Starting a sentence with “Also” is informal; “In addition” or “Moreover” is preferred, or move “also” inside.
explanation.ar: بدء الجملة بـ Also أسلوب غير رسمي، والأفضل In addition أو Moreover أو نقل also إلى داخل الجملة.

prompt.en: What is the writer's overall position on remote work?
prompt.ar: ما موقف الكاتب العام من العمل عن بُعد؟

options: It has real costs as well as real benefits.
It is clearly better than working in an office.
It is a passing habit that will soon disappear.
It works only for very experienced staff.

explanation.en: The first paragraph lists benefits; “There is another side to it” signals the costs. The conclusion is balanced.
explanation.ar: الفقرة الأولى تعدّد المزايا، وعبارة There is another side to it تنبّه إلى العيوب، فالخلاصة متوازنة.

prompt.en: What does “however” in the first paragraph tell you?
prompt.ar: ماذا تفيد however في الفقرة الأولى؟

options: The situation has changed from what came before.
The writer is adding another benefit.
The writer is giving an example of a privilege.
The writer is summarising the whole article.

explanation.en: It contrasts “once a rare privilege” with what is true today.
explanation.ar: تقابل بين «امتياز نادر في الماضي» وبين الحال اليوم.

prompt.en: Why did companies choose a hybrid arrangement?

options: It is the least damaging compromise, not the perfect answer.
It is the ideal model for almost every kind of company.
Junior staff specifically asked their managers for it.
It removes the need to hire outside the company's own city.

explanation.en: “Not because it is ideal, but because it loses the least” states this directly.
explanation.ar: العبارة الأخيرة تقول ذلك صراحة: ليس لأنه مثالي بل لأنه أقل الخيارات خسارة.

prompt.en: According to the text, what do junior staff lose at home?
prompt.ar: بحسب النص، ماذا يفقد الموظفون الجدد في المنزل؟

options: Learning by overhearing experienced colleagues.
The chance to be promoted to a manager.
Access to the company's computer systems.
Any contact at all with their own team.

explanation.en: The text says they learn “by simply overhearing experienced colleagues”, and that disappears.
explanation.ar: يقول النص إنهم يتعلمون بمجرد سماع زملائهم الخبراء، وهذا يختفي في المنزل.

questions.sentence: ___ working extra hours, they missed the deadline.
options: Despite
Although
However
Because

explanation.en: “Working” is an -ing form, not a clause, so “despite” fits and “although” does not.
explanation.ar: كلمة working صيغة ing لا جملة، فتناسبها despite ولا تناسبها although.

questions.answer: As a result the prices went up sharply

explanation.en: “As a result” opens the sentence that states the consequence.
explanation.ar: تبدأ عبارة As a result الجملة التي تذكر النتيجة.

prompt.en: Which sentence best opens a paragraph arguing FOR online study?
prompt.ar: أي جملة تصلح افتتاحاً لفقرة تؤيد الدراسة عبر الإنترنت؟

options: Online study suits people who are already working full time.
In my opinion I think that online study is good for the people.
There are many things about online study and also other things.
Online study, it has some advantages and some disadvantages too.

explanation.en: A topic sentence makes one clear claim. The others are vague, repetitive, or sit on the fence.
explanation.ar: الجملة الافتتاحية تطرح ادعاءً واضحاً واحداً، أما البقية فمبهمة أو مكررة أو محايدة بلا موقف.

prompt.en: Match the linker with its job.

explanation.en: Readers use these words to predict what is coming — using the wrong one misleads them.
explanation.ar: يستعين القارئ بهذه الكلمات ليتوقع ما سيأتي، فاختيار الخاطئة يضلّله.
